title: Physics parity golden
description: Initial state, scenario and golden observables of one browser-twin scenario, written by st50_physics in Warp's deterministic mode (DC-005-06, spec 005-physics).

engine.description: web engine id of the twin (spec 018 engine table)

scenario.description: the scenario parameters (DC-005-01) the golden was produced with; seed and parameters live here

kind.description: benchmark run, browser-twin parity golden, or production rollout (any scenario that is not a benchmark)

device.description: cpu hides CUDA from the process (FR-005-49)

deterministic.description: Warp deterministic execution mode for atomic operations (FR-005-48)

scenario_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 canonical JSON of scenario

outputs_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the deterministic run's outputs (FR-005-22, FR-005-48)

layout.description: little-endian float32 arrays: particle positions and velocities (2-D or 3-D), or the depth and bed grids

items.description: particles or cells (twin caps: 2 x 10^4 particles, 256 x 256 cells)

mass_drift_rel.description: |total mass (or volume) at the end - initial| / initial; bounded by the loosest conservation requirement of the twin solvers (FR-005-28)

scenario_benchmark_id.description: physics benchmark ids; the prefix is the solver id

rayleigh_fraction.description: f_R of the time-step guard (FR-005-08, default 0.2)

grid_cells.description: cells per axis of the square grid

scenario_quantity.description: a material or vehicle value with its citation and verification status; the unit is the suffix of the field name

scenario_solver.description: own Warp DEM, Newton implicit MPM, own explicit 2-D MLS-MPM twin, own shallow water, own Lagrangian dust, reduced-order vehicles, Newton rigid bodies

scenario_status.description: verification status of a value: verified (primary source read), unverified (secondary or unreadable source), calibrated (fitted), reduced (deliberately lowered Young's modulus, FR-005-09), assumed (modelling choice)

dt_s.description: fixed step; the shallow-water solver uses the CFL step instead (FR-005-23)

road.description: a constant-grade segment (geometry.grade_pct) or the road network (DC-004-06)
